title: Pre-Registration: EFC dN/dM (z>7) Halo Mass Function via µ(a) Perturbation Channel
description: Sealed pre-registration of an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the high-redshift (z=7–12) halo mass function n(M,z) derived through the µ(a) perturbation channel. The work locks the structural chain g(a) → µ(a) → D(a) → σ(M,z) → n(M,z), specifies datasets and falsification criteria, and commits to three HMF prescriptions (Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, Tinker) under identical baryonic mapping to isolate the cosmology channel.

background_energy_modification.description: Background-level EFC modification to the normalized Hubble rate via the gate function g(a); sign lemma implies \Delta E^2 \le 0 for z>0 under monotonic g(a).

gate_function.description: Monotonic gate controlling the activation of the EFC channel, with transition redshift z_t and sharpness n.

effective_gravitational_coupling.description: EFC perturbation-channel modification to the Poisson source; typically \mu(a) < 1 when the gate is active.

modified_growth_equation.description: ODE for the logarithmic growth rate f \equiv d\ln D/d\ln a with EFC-modified source; integrates to the linear growth factor D(a).

omega_tilde_definition.description: Effective matter fraction entering the growth equation.

variance_sigma.description: Mass-variance computed from a Planck-anchored linear power spectrum and the EFC-modified growth factor.

hmf_general.description: General halo mass function form; f(\nu) taken as Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, and Tinker 2008/2010 to bracket modeling uncertainty.

key_results.main_finding: A sealed, structurally rigid prediction for the z=7–12 halo mass function in EFC is registered via the µ(a) perturbation channel with predefined falsification thresholds and dataset commitments.
datasets_used: Joint S(z) background fit (validation candidate vc 4ea464e38b5f)

sealed_predictions.statement: Given (B, z_t, n) fixed solely by the joint S(z) fit, the EFC chain g(a) → µ(a) → D(a) → σ(M,z) → n(M,z) uniquely determines the halo mass function at z=7,8,9,10,11,12 under Planck-anchored P_lin and identical SMHM mapping as ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A >3σ disagreement between the sealed EFC n(M,z) predictions (converted to number counts under the shared mapping) and JWST CEERS/COSMOS-Web/GLASS measurements in any redshift bin.

sealed_predictions.statement: In the gate-active regime, µ(a)=1−B g(a) remains below unity (µ(a)<1) with g(a) monotonic in a and ΔE^2(a) ≤ 0 for z>0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Empirical or calibration requirements forcing B<0 (µ(a)>1 at high z) or a non-monotonic g(a) that violates the sign lemma.

sealed_predictions.statement: Across Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, and Tinker prescriptions fed the same σ(M,z), the predicted counts remain within the acceptance region (Δχ² < 4) for the JWST z=7–12 datasets.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: All three HMF prescriptions generated from the sealed σ(M,z) yield Δχ² above the acceptance bound or >3σ tension with the data.

kill_criteria: KC1: Any >3σ disagreement between the sealed EFC n(M,z) predictions (converted to counts with the identical SMHM mapping as ΛCDM) and JWST CEERS, COSMOS-Web, or GLASS measurements in any of the z=7–12 bins falsifies the EFC L3 µ(a) HMF prediction.

KC2: If achieving agreement with the HMF data requires altering the sealed chain (changing the form of g(a), µ(a), growth ODE, σ integration, or the fixed Planck-anchored P_lin), the preregistered prediction is invalidated.

KC3: Failure of the joint S(z) background fit to produce (B, z_t, n) within EBE bounds consistent with background and perturbation data prevents instantiation of the prediction and is counted as a failed test of the L3 µ(a) channel.

KC4: Calibration or data demands that imply µ(a) > 1 at high redshift (requiring B < 0) or a non-monotonic g(a) (violating ΔE^2(a) ≤ 0 for z>0) falsify the preregistered EFC assumptions for this test.
